Title: A Day to Remember

Cast

1. Kunal - 9 years, son
Look: glasses, green shirt, black trousers
2. Anita - 39 years, mother
Look: green saree

Places

1. The courtyard - a brick floor, a tulsi plant
2. The road - a paved road, trees along it

Scene 1: The courtyard - Day

[Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "What lovely weather!"

[Kunal hides behind the tree.]

Kunal (happily): "Exactly right."

[Kunal waves goodbye to Mother.]

Kunal (happily): "That was fun!"

[Kunal draws a picture of the house.]

Kunal: "Mom, listen!"

[Smoke rises from the chimney.]

Anita: "Careful!"

Scene 2: The road - Day

[Kunal stands by the road. Anita stands near him.]

Anita: "Let's begin."

[Kunal rides his bicycle down the road.]

Kunal (surprised): "One more time!"

[Kunal gets into the car.]

Kunal: "What happened?"

[Kunal gets on the bus.]

Anita: "Well done!"

Scene 3: The courtyard - Day

[It is raining heavily. Kunal stands in the courtyard. Anita stands near him.]

Kunal: "Let's begin."

[Kunal opens his umbrella.]

Kunal: "What next?"

[Kunal puts on his raincoat.]

Kunal: "That was such a fun day!"
